description: This file defines quantization-aware training modules for embedding and embedding bag layers in PyTorch, including classes Embedding and EmbeddingBag with methods for conversion from float modules and handling fake quantization.

classes.name: Embedding
classes.description: A quantization-aware training module for embedding layers, extending torch.nn.Embedding with fake quantization capabilities.

classes.name: EmbeddingBag
classes.description: A quantization-aware training module for embedding bag layers, extending torch.nn.EmbeddingBag with fake quantization capabilities.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs embedding lookup with fake quantized weights.

methods.name: from_float
methods.description: Creates a quantized embedding or embedding bag module from a float module.

methods.name: to_float
methods.description: Converts the quantized module back to a float module.
